summary: Mid-stretch of a narrow residential street where cars park, but steep with homes close.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb
Homes 10-16 m away on both sides

best_section.where: Kings Road west kerb, midway up the straight, in the run of parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 10 m behind the kerb at the start and flats 14-16 m away across the road; no home within 10 m of this part.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; a van fits in line with them.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential dead-end style street; railway noise from the north.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 9% here, 14% over the whole line
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover over the kerb and gardens; sun from the east and west reaches the lane.
